fields.description: Trusted, admin-configured execution identity. Required for every trigger type -- for DocType Event this is the fail-closed fallback if the real triggering user (the one whose save/submit fired the event) doesn't resolve to a valid identity; for Schedule/Webhook it is the *only* identity source, since neither has a real interactive triggering user. Never Administrator, never Guest (enforced in validate()).
fields.label: Service User

fields.description: Allowlisted events only -- never an arbitrary Python hook method name.
fields.label: Event
fields.options:
after_insert
on_update
on_submit
on_cancel
on_trash
on_update_after_submit

fields.description: Standard 5-field cron expression, validated via croniter at save time.
fields.label: Cron Format

fields.description: Updated each time this trigger fires. A single shared, native Frappe Scheduled Job Type record (created once at migrate time -- see itsuperapp.agent_flow.triggers) re-checks every enabled Schedule trigger's cron_format against this field each minute; no per-trigger scheduled job is created (issue #62 -- reuses Frappe's own scheduler, no custom cron engine).
fields.label: Last Run

fields.description: Auto-generated, unguessable path segment scoping this trigger's webhook URL -- not secret itself (safe to display/copy), only the HMAC secret below is.
fields.label: Webhook Key

fields.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for inbound webhook requests. Encrypted at rest (Password fieldtype) -- never a plaintext Data field.
fields.label: Webhook Secret
